name: google_qa_question_type_reason_explanation
description:
Given a question and an answer (from the Crowdsource team at Google) as well as additional
    category features, predict the (subjective) type of the question in relation to the answer. These data
    stem from the same source as qaa, where the different labels were both prediction targets in the
    original (multi-label) Kaggle competition.
  
 Dataset found from the paper: Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
creator: Xingjian Shi, Jonas Mueller, Nick Erickson, Mu Li, Alexander J. Smola
citation: Shi, X., Mueller, J., Erickson, N., Li, M., & Smola, A. J. (2021). Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
